verdict.rationale: An in-app AI assistant that learns a user's tone and preferences is a fair question for a collaboration and project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only MCP support, a CLI and skills for external AI agents, and the ability to invite AI agents into projects. These are integration building blocks, not a native assistant that learns tone, shorthand or preferences.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
